title: VDS proof result
description: Machine output a warrant was granted against. Governed by VDS S-7. Written by the checker as a side effect of running. A hand-written proof record is void (VDS S-7(2)(5)), and this schema does NOT establish that on its own: capture_mode is a string an author can type, so fixing it to one value only makes a forgery say the right word. What binds a record to an execution is the pair (script, script_digest), both required here and both re-checked against the file on disk before the record may be cited as evidence, plus `digest`, which covers the record's own result fields.

kind.description: A closed registry (VDS S-7(5)). Adding a kind amends the specification and the invariant registry; it is not a script anyone may drop in.

status.description: vacuous means the check exited 0 over zero enforceable rows. A vacuous proof is not evidence for any warrant (VDS S-7(2)(4)).

warrant_id.description: Set when this proof is cited by a warrant. Null on a routine gate run.

command.description: The exact argv that produced this result. Re-running it must reproduce the same digest (VDS S-7(2)(1)).

script.description: Path of the proof script that produced this record, relative to the repository that holds it. It must be the canonical script for `kind` (tools/proofs/<kind>.py), so a record cannot cite a real script's digest under a kind that script does not implement. Must appear in .vds/enforcement.lock when a lock is present (VDS S-8(3)).

script_digest.description: sha256 of the script as it was when this record was captured. Required. Re-checked against the file on disk before the record may be cited as warrant evidence: if the script has changed, this record is stale evidence and is refused, and if the script does not exist at all the record is refused as a record of nothing.

rows_considered.description: Every row the check looked at, including rows it could not enforce.

rows_enforced.description: Rows in an enforceable state. Zero with exit_code 0 is vacuous, never passed (VDS S-7(2)(4)).

rows_skipped_reasons.description: Count per reason a row was considered but not enforced, so a vacuous pass is diagnosable rather than merely flagged.

location.description: file:line, or a route plus a component id.

rule.description: The invariant id or statute section the violation offends.

inputs_digest.description: Digest over every input the check read, so a result can be tied to the state it was produced from.

digest.description: Digest of the check's own normalised output. This is the value a warrant cites.

designpack_digest.description: The designpack digest in force when the check ran, from .vds/designpack.lock.

capture_mode.description: Fixed. A record claiming any other capture mode is not a proof (VDS S-7(2)(5)). This field is a declaration, not a guarantee: it is the script binding above that makes it checkable.

invoked_by.description: manual is recorded honestly and does not satisfy VDS S-7(2)(3).
